{{Quote|The Mandalorian destroyed my first life, on ''Quelii''. Since then, I've answered to names others gave me&mdash;names that weren't ''mine''&mdash;because I didn't ''care.'' My home was gone. What did it ''matter'' who I was?|Malak|<ref name="kotor42">[[Knights of the Old Republic 42|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 42]]</ref>}}
'''Quelii''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], which maintained a population of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who lived in villages. Quelii was devastated by a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Battle of Quelii|attack]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Mandalorian Wars]], although some natives managed to escape the onslaught and make it to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. One of these refugees grew to become the infamous [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Malak]], who led a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|army]] against the Republic in the [[Jedi Civil War]].

==Description==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Quelii was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|sector]] and [[Quelii system/Legends|system]] of the same name. The planet was capable of supporting [[Human/Legends|Human]] life.<ref name="kotor42" />

==History==
The planet Quelii was originally settled in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Mandalorian Wars]], and a culture that included Humans developed there. Quelii came [[Battle of Quelii|under attack]] by the band of warriors known as the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]] several years before their invasion of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and the invaders devastated the world. Although Quelii's society was more or less destroyed after the Mandalorian raid, some natives managed to escape and continue their lives in Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="kotor42" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|We didn't have surnames on Quelii, only names of our home village. That's what wound up on the immigration records after we escaped.|Malak|<ref name="kotor31" />}}
In the years prior to the Mandalorian Wars, Quelii maintained a native population that included Humans, centered around villages. Natives of Quelii did not have familial surnames, although some who fled the world after the Mandalorian attack ended up with the names of their home villages standing in for last names on their immigration records. Among those who escaped the Mandalorians was a young man named [[Darth Malak|Alek]], a native of the village [[Squinquargesimus]], who became a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and one of the leading proponents of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] intervention in the Mandalorian Wars.<ref name="kotor31" /> Eventually, Alek fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and became the infamous [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] known as Darth Malak, who led a [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|force]] of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] against the Jedi and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] in the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="kotor">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Quelii was first mentioned in [[Knights of the Old Republic 29|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 29]], an issue of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series, written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and released in [[2008]].<ref name="kotor29">[[Knights of the Old Republic 29|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 29]]</ref> Quelii went on to be mentioned in several other sources, although it never directly appeared in a ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'' work.
